changes: With MUTE ALL SOUND, RTRG + a muted pad in LIVE RECORDING now records the whole roll, in silence.
A muted pad no longer takes the voice it shares: with CH muted, OH keeps ringing, with no click.
A muted pad lights up on each recorded hit, as a sounding pad does.
Outside LIVE RECORDING muted pads stay silent, as before.
FUNC + TRIG now plays the track at the TRIG page's VEL wherever TRIG keys are silent, the way a plain TRIG press plays on stock.
The LIVE REC row now covers TRIG keys too, and is renamed SILENT P+T LIVEREC: a TRIG key selects silently and records nothing, and FUNC + TRIG plays and records.
GRID and STEP RECORDING keep stock's FUNC + TRIG.
After updating, all three rows start unchecked: check the ones you use again once.
First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: three checkboxes in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
SILENT PAD+TRIG: pads and TRIG keys select their track without playing it. FUNC + pad still plays.
SILENT PAD LIVEREC: pads stay silent in LIVE RECORDING too.
MUTE ALL SOUND: a muted track stays silent from pads, TRIG keys and MIDI, while its trigs still record.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build, MIDI out and STEP REC. The module page now credits Nathaniel Pavel (@npp1993).
